text: It is our series, Ivan said after a long silence, so there is a chance that we have really won. <break time="0.8s" /> Well, then look at the ticket number, she said, but he answered, Wait a little, we have plenty of time to be disappointed. <break time="0.8s" /> It is on the second line from the top, so the prize is 75, 000, which is not just money but power and capital. <break time="0.8s" /> Husband and wife began to laugh and stare at each other in silence, for the very possibility of winning had confused them. <break time="0.8s" /> They could not even say what they wanted or what they would buy, and they could only think of the numbers 9, 499 and 75, 000. <break time="0.8s" /> Ivan walked from corner to corner with the paper in his hand, and only after the first shock had passed did he begin to dream. <break time="0.8s" /> The ticket is yours, of course, but if it were mine, I would first spend 25, 000 on an estate in the country, he said. <break time="0.8s" /> I would use 10, 000 for new furniture, travel, and paying debts, and I would put the other 40, 000 in the bank. <break time="0.8s" /> Yes, an estate would be nice, said his wife, sitting down slowly and dropping her hands into her lap. <break time="0.8s" /> Pictures began to crowd into his imagination, each one lovelier and more poetic than the one before.
